description: Run your bol.com shop: follow and ship orders, cancel items, handle returns, create offers and set their prices and stock, check competing offers, and start workflows on new orders and returns.

bol_com_cancellation_requested_trigger.description: Runs each time a customer asks to cancel an order item that hasn't shipped yet. Accept it with 'Cancel order item' and the reason Requested by the customer. Requests made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.fulfilment_method: FBR if you ship it, FBB if bol.com does.
output.order_item_id: The item to cancel, for 'Cancel order item'.
output.requested_at: When the item last changed, which is when cancellation was asked.

parameters.description: ALL for every order, FBR for orders you ship yourself, or FBB for those bol.com ships. Leave empty for every order.
parameters.name: fulfilment_method

bol_com_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new bol.com order. Orders placed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.item_count: How many different items it has.
output.order_item_ids: Each item's orderItemId, for 'Ship order items'.
output.order_items: Each item, with its quantity and fulfilment method.

parameters.description: ALL for every order, FBR for orders you ship yourself, or FBB for those bol.com ships. Leave empty for every order.
parameters.name: fulfilment_method

bol_com_new_return_trigger.description: Runs for each new return a customer registers. Returns registered before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.customer_comments: What the customer wrote about it.
output.fulfilment_method: FBR if you ship the product, FBB if bol.com does.
output.order_id: The order the first returned item was in.
output.reason: The customer's main reason for the first item.
output.return_items: Each returned item, with its reason and how it was handled.
output.rma_ids: Each returned item's rmaId, for 'Handle a return'.

parameters.description: FBR for those you ship yourself, or FBB for those bol.com ships. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: fulfilment_method

bol_com_new_shipment_trigger.description: Runs for each new bol.com shipment, whether you shipped it or bol.com did. Shipments made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.shipment_reference: The reference given when it shipped.
output.transport_id: bol.com's id for the parcel's transport.

parameters.description: FBR for shipments you send yourself, or FBB for those bol.com sends. Leave empty for yours.
parameters.name: fulfilment_method

bol_com_offer_changed_trigger.description: Runs for each offer added or changed, by you or by bol.com (such as going on or off sale). Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.for_sale_in: The countries it is for sale in now: NL, BE, both or none.
output.price: Its price for one, in euros.

bol_com_return_handled_trigger.description: Runs each time a return is handled, by you or by bol.com's warehouse. Ones handled before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.customer_comments: What the customer wrote about it.
output.fulfilment_method: FBR if you ship the product, FBB if bol.com does.
output.order_id: The order the first returned item was in.
output.reason: The customer's main reason for the first item.
output.return_items: Each returned item, with its reason and how it was handled.
output.rma_ids: Each returned item's rmaId, for 'Handle a return'.

parameters.description: FBR for those you ship yourself, or FBB for those bol.com ships. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: fulfilment_method
